valid.code: for (let i = 0, len = arr.length; i < len; i++) { use(arr[i]); }
valid.name: properly memoized length variable, never reassigned in the body - not flagged
unrelated bound (Literal, not a memoized length or a direct .length re-read) - not flagged

valid.code: let len = arr.length; let i = 0; while (i < len) { use(arr[i]); i++; }
valid.name: while loop with a properly memoized length variable, never reassigned - not flagged

valid.code: let len = arr.length; for (let i = 0; i < len; i++) { total += other.length; }
valid.name: loop body reassigns an UNRELATED variable's .length, not the compared memo variable itself - not flagged

invalid.code: for (let i = 0; i < arr.length; i++) { use(arr[i]); }
invalid.name: classic direct arr.length re-read every iteration - flagged

invalid.code: for (let i = 0; arr.length > i; i++) { use(arr[i]); }
invalid.name: reversed operands (arr.length > i) - flagged

invalid.code: for (let i = 0; i < arr['length']; i++) { use(arr[i]); }
invalid.name: bracket notation arr["length"] - flagged as equivalent to arr.length

invalid.code: let i = 0; while (i < arr.length) { use(arr[i]); i++; }
invalid.name: while loop instead of for - flagged

invalid.code: for (let i = 0; i <= arr.length; i++) { use(arr[i]); }
invalid.name: <= comparison operator - flagged alongside <

invalid.code: for (let i = 0; arr.length >= i; i++) { use(arr[i]); }
invalid.name: >= comparison operator, reversed operands - flagged

invalid.code: let len = arr.length; for (let i = 0; i < len; i++) { len = arr.length; use(arr[i]); }
invalid.name: "memoized" variable reassigned to arr.length inside the loop body every iteration - defeats the memoization, flagged

invalid.code: let len = arr.length; let i = 0; while (i < len) { len = arr.length; i++; }
invalid.name: while-loop variant of the reassigned-memo bypass - flagged

invalid.code: let len = arr.length; for (let i = 0; i < len; i++) { len = arr['length']; use(arr[i]); }
invalid.name: reassignment via bracket notation arr["length"] - flagged the same as dot notation
